examples.expected_output: raises OutOfBoundsDatetime, match="overflows past" (e.g. 'Converting ... overflows past 2262-04-11 23:47:16.854775807')
examples.buggy_output_reported: ValueError ... is a nonexistent time due to daylight savings time (zoneinfo fallback past the last cached DST transition wrapped instead of reporting an out-of-bounds UTC instant); with nonexistent="NaT" it returned NaT silently

examples.input: dti = DatetimeIndex(np.array([-(2**63) + 9 * 3600 * 10**9], dtype="i8").view("M8[ns]")); dti.tz_localize(tz) with tz in [timezone(timedelta(hours=9)), ZoneInfo("Etc/GMT-9")]
examples.buggy_output_reported: no exception: the fixed-offset loop only checked int64 wrap, so the shift landed exactly on the NaT sentinel (-(2**63)) and was stored; the wall time read back as missing data

examples.input: val = Timestamp.max._value - 2 * 3600 * 10**9; dti = DatetimeIndex(np.array([val, val - 10**9], dtype="i8").view("M8[ns]")); dti.tz_localize(tz) with tz in [timezone(timedelta(hours=-5)), ZoneInfo("Etc/GMT+5")]
examples.buggy_output_reported: no exception: the out-of-range UTC instant past Timestamp.max wrapped to a negative year instead of raising

examples.input: dti = DatetimeIndex(np.array([-(2**63) + 9 * 3600 * 10**9], dtype="i8").view("M8[ns]")); with tm.set_timezone("Asia/Tokyo"): dti.tz_localize(dateutil.tz.tzlocal())
examples.buggy_output_reported: no exception: the tzlocal loop lacks the sentinel guard, so the NaT sentinel was stored and the wall time read back as missing data

examples.input: val = Timestamp.max._value - 2 * 3600 * 10**9; dti = DatetimeIndex(np.array([val, val - 10**9], dtype="i8").view("M8[ns]")); with tm.set_timezone("US/Eastern"): dti.tz_localize(dateutil.tz.tzlocal())
examples.buggy_output_reported: no exception: same bare-subtraction overflow in the tzlocal loop, the UTC instant wrapped instead of being reported out of bounds

examples.input: ts = Timestamp(-(2**63) + 9 * 3600 * 10**9) shifted through the scalar fixed-offset branch (and the scalar tzlocal branch) during tz_localize
examples.buggy_output_reported: no OutOfBoundsDatetime: the scalar branch stored the NaT sentinel (message matched against the Timestamp(..., tz=) constructor text)
